title: An unknown room is refused with an Error, not a RangeError (it is not a value out of bounds); the @throws line on the handle is forgotten
covers: kind of error changed in code, the @throws line on the kind not
rule 29 checks only errors stated on the function or method itself
note: Bookings still states '@throws {RangeError} quote when the room is unknown'. billing's estimate test expects bookings' RangeError for an unknown room and now gets an Error.
